title.en: CHP records three more severe paediatric flu cases
title.zh: 卫生署报告三宗严重儿童流感个案

summary.en: The Centre for Health Protection (CHP) reported three severe flu cases in children on Saturday. All were previously healthy. A six-year-old girl is in critical condition in intensive care, while a three-year-old girl and a 15-year-old boy remain in serious condition.
summary.zh: 卫生防护中心（CHP）周六报告了三宗儿童严重流感个案。所有儿童之前都身体健康。一名六岁女孩情况危急，正在接受深切治疗，而一名三岁女孩和一名十五岁男孩仍处于严重状态。

body.en: The Centre for Health Protection (CHP) on Saturday reported three more severe flu cases in children, all of whom were previously healthy with no underlying conditions. One of them, a six-year-old girl, is currently in critical condition and placed under intensive care at Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital. She developed a fever, cough and runny nose on Thursday. Two of her classmates also showed mild flu-like symptoms recently, though neither required hospitalisation. Meanwhile, a three-year-old girl and a 15-year-old boy remain in serious condition. All household contacts of the three patients are currently asymptomatic. Edwin Tsui, Controller of the CHP, said overall flu activity has stayed high since the summer influenza season began. He noted that 16 severe paediatric cases have been recorded since the end of June, including one fatality, with two other patients currently in critical condition. Tsui warned that more outbreaks are expected following the start of the new academic year, urging both parents and schools to stay vigilant and maintain preventive measures. Members of the public are also urged to get vaccinated when the annual Seasonal Influenza Vaccination Programmes begin on September 17. Edited by Azam Khan
body.zh: 卫生防护中心（CHP）周六报告了三起严重的儿童流感病例，所有这些儿童之前都很健康，没有任何潜在疾病。其中一名六岁女童现时情况危急，在东区尤德夫人那打素医院接受重症监护。周四，她出现发烧、咳嗽和流鼻涕的症状。她的两名同学最近也出现了轻微的流感样症状，但两人都不需要住院治疗。与此同时，一名 3 岁女孩和一名 15 岁男孩仍伤势严重。目前，三名患者的所有家庭接触者均无症状。卫生防护中心总监徐埃德温表示，自夏季流感季节开始以来，整体流感活动一直居高不下。他指出，自6月底以来，已记录了16例严重儿科病例，其中1人死亡，另外两名患者目前情况危急。徐警告说，新学年开始后预计会出现更多疫情，敦促家长和学校保持警惕并采取预防措施。年度季节性流感疫苗接种计划于 9 月 17 日开始时，我们还敦促公众接种疫苗。编辑：Azam Khan

reflection.en: The news of severe flu cases in children, particularly the six-year-old girl in critical condition, calls us to remember the fragility of life and the importance of prayer. James 5:14 reminds us to call for the elders of the church to pray over those who are sick, anointing them with oil in the name of Yahweh, trusting in divine healing and comfort.
reflection.zh: 儿童严重流感个案的新闻，特别是那名情况危急的六岁女孩，提醒我们生命的脆弱以及祷告的重要性。雅各书5章14节提醒我们，要为病人请教会长来祷告，奉主的名用油膏他们，信靠雅伟的医治与安慰。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Safety or hostility? Dog owners split over Hong Kong’s crackdown on leash rules
title.zh: 安全还是敌意？香港的狗主人对收紧牵绳规定意见不一

summary.en: Hong Kong authorities' intensified enforcement against dog owners who fail to control their pets has drawn mixed reactions, with supporters welcoming improved safety and critics warning it is stoking panic and hostility. The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department carried out inspections and enforcement...
summary.zh: 香港当局加强了对未能控制宠物的狗主人的执法力度，此举引发了褒贬不一的反应。支持者欢迎提高安全性，批评者则警告此举正在煽动恐慌和敌意。在最近发生了一系列狗咬人事件后，渔农自然护理署于周六在全港范围内开展了检查和执法行动。

body.en: Hong Kong authorities’ intensified enforcement against dog owners who fail to control their pets has drawn mixed reactions, with supporters welcoming improved safety and critics warning it is stoking panic and hostility. The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department carried out inspections and enforcement operations across the city on Saturday following a spate of dog attacks in recent weeks. Among those walking their pets at the West Kowloon Cultural District despite the heat were...
body.zh: 香港当局对未能控制宠物的狗主人加强执法，引起了不同的反应，支持者对安全措施的改善表示欢迎，批评者则警告称，这会引发恐慌和敌意。在近几周发生多起狗袭击事件后，渔农自然护理署周六在全市范围内进行了检查和执法行动。尽管天气炎热，在西九文化区遛宠物的人中...

reflection.en: The enforcement of leash rules in Hong Kong has created a divide, with some seeing enhanced safety and others feeling hostility. This situation calls to mind the biblical exhortation to be kind and compassionate towards one another. May we seek to overcome division with empathy, remembering that understanding and gentleness can bridge the gaps that anger...
reflection.zh: 香港收紧牵绳规定的执法行动在市民中造成了分歧，一些人认为这提高了安全性，而另一些人则感到敌意。这种情况让人联想到圣经中劝勉我们要彼此恩慈、心存怜悯。愿我们寻求以同理心化解分歧，并牢记理解与温和能够弥合愤怒和恐惧所造成的隔阂。

verse.textEn: Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other, just as in Christ God forgave you.
verse.textZh: 并要以恩慈相待，存怜悯的心，彼此饶恕，正如神在基督里饶恕了你们一样。

title.en: Hong Kong mega bridge’s popularity takes toll on helicopter, ferry services: lawmaker
title.zh: 香港大桥的受欢迎程度对直升机和渡轮服务造成了影响：议员

summary.en: The number of vehicles using the mega bridge connecting Hong Kong with Zhuhai and Macau reached a record high of 5.21 million last year, a 19% increase from the previous year. A lawmaker stated that this boom has significantly impacted ferry and helicopter services.
summary.zh: 连接香港与珠海、澳门的超级大桥去年车辆使用量创下新高，达到521万辆，比前一年增长了19%。一位议员表示，这一繁荣景象对渡轮和直升机服务造成了严重影响。

body.en: The number of vehicles using a mega bridge linking Hong Kong with Zhuhai and Macau hit a record high last year, the South China Morning Post has learned, with a lawmaker saying the boom has taken a heavy toll on ferry services and a long-running helicopter service. Transport Department figures obtained by the SCMP showed that vehicle flow via the popular Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge reached a record high of 5.21 million last year, up more than 19 per cent from 4.36 million in 2024. The 2025...
body.zh: 据《南华早报》获悉，去年使用连接香港、珠海和澳门的巨型大桥的车辆数量创下历史新高，一名立法者表示，这种繁荣对渡轮服务和长期运行的直升机服务造成了沉重打击。 《南华早报》获得的运输署数据显示，去年通过热门港珠澳大桥的车流量创下历史新高，达 521 万辆，比 2024 年的 436 万辆增加逾 19%。2025 年...

reflection.en: The surge in traffic on the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge, while a sign of connectivity, has created unintended consequences for other transport services. This situation calls for leadership that governs with integrity, ensuring that progress in one area does not unduly harm others, reflecting the principle of righteous rule that benefits the whole...
reflection.zh: 香港-珠海-澳门大桥车流量的激增，虽然是连通性的体现，却给其他交通服务带来了意想不到的后果。这种情况呼唤着以诚信治理的领导力，确保一个领域的发展不会不当损害其他领域，体现了造福整个社群的公义统治原则。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: 14 fall ill after dining at Eaton HK hotel restaurant
title.zh: 14 人在油麻地一酒店餐厅用餐后不适

summary.en: Hong Kong health authorities have identified seven additional suspected food poisoning cases linked to a hotel restaurant in Yau Ma Tei, bringing the total number of affected diners to 14. The Centre for Health Protection stated on Saturday that it had identified three additional food poisoning clusters involving The...
summary.zh: 香港卫生当局在油麻地一家酒店餐厅发现了七起新的疑似食物中毒病例，使受影响的用餐者总数达到14人。卫生防护中心周六表示，继9月3日宣布两个聚集性病例后，又发现了涉及香港逸东酒店 Astor 餐厅的三起新的食物中毒聚集性病例。初步调查显示，所有五个聚集性病例在流行病学上有关联。

body.en: Hong Kong health authorities have detected seven additional suspected food poisoning cases linked to a hotel restaurant in Yau Ma Tei, raising the total number of affected diners to 14. The Centre for Health Protection said on Saturday it had identified three additional food poisoning clusters involving The Astor restaurant at Eaton HK, after initially announcing two clusters on September 3. “The centre’s preliminary investigations revealed that all five clusters are epidemiologically linked,”...
body.zh: 香港卫生当局又发现七宗疑似食物中毒个案，与油麻地一间酒店餐厅有关，使受影响的食客总数增至 14 人。卫生防护中心周六表示，继 9 月 3 日宣布两起集体食物中毒事件后，周六又发现三起涉及香港逸东利顺德餐厅的食物中毒集体事件。“中心初步调查显示，所有五个集体食物中毒事件均存在流行病学关联”。

reflection.en: A total of 14 diners have fallen ill, with suspected food poisoning linked to a hotel restaurant in Yau Ma Tei. This news brings to mind the verse, 'Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to account, and let them pray over them—anointing them with oil in the name of Yahweh.' While this incident is a matter for health authorities,...
reflection.zh: 共有14名食客出现不适，疑似食物中毒与油麻地一家酒店餐厅有关。这一消息令人想起经文：“你们中间有人患病吗？他就该请教会的长老来；他们当为他祷告，用油抹他，奉主的名。” 尽管此次事件属于卫生部门的管辖范围，但它也提醒我们，在灵性上，有责任关怀那些生病的人，为他们的康复和福祉祈祷。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Inaugural Global Education Summit explores AI, future talent and changing pathways
title.zh: 首届全球教育峰会探讨人工智能、未来人才和变革路径

summary.en: Over 2,000 policymakers, educators, and parents from across the globe convened in Hong Kong on Saturday for the first Global Education Summit. The event centered on regional talent development, the integration of artificial intelligence, and evolving academic pathways. This two-day summit, co-organized by the South...
summary.zh: 周六，来自世界各地的两千多名政策制定者、教育工作者和家长齐聚香港，参加首届全球教育峰会。此次峰会聚焦区域人才发展、人工智能整合以及不断变化的学术路径。为期两天的峰会由南华早报和汇丰 Premier 联合主办，旨在帮助家长和学生应对日益复杂的教育选择。

body.en: More than 2,000 policymakers, educators and parents from around the world gathered in Hong Kong on Saturday for the inaugural Global Education Summit, which focused on regional talent development, artificial intelligence integration and changing academic pathways. The two-day event, held at the Grand Hyatt Hong Kong in Wan Chai and co-organised by the South China Morning Post and HSBC Premier, aims to help parents and students navigate an increasingly complex range of academic options. It caters...
body.zh: 来自世界各地的 2000 多名政策制定者、教育工作者和家长周六齐聚香港，参加首届全球教育峰会，重点讨论区域人才发展、人工智能整合和改变学术路径。这项为期两天的活动在湾仔香港君悦酒店举行，由《南华早报》和汇丰卓越理财联合主办，旨在帮助家长和学生应对日益复杂的学术选择。它迎合...

reflection.en: The Global Education Summit in Hong Kong highlights humanity's relentless pursuit of knowledge and innovation, particularly with the integration of AI. Daniel's prophecy speaks of a time when "knowledge will increase," a sentiment echoed in this gathering focused on shaping future talent. As we navigate these advancements, may we seek wisdom to use these...
reflection.zh: 在香港举行的全球教育峰会彰显了人类对知识和创新的不懈追求，尤其是在人工智能的融合方面。但以理的预言谈到了“知识增长”的时代，这与此次聚焦塑造未来人才的聚会不谋而合。当我们驾驭这些进步时，愿我们寻求智慧，以善意运用这些工具，并牢记真正的进步不仅以能力衡量，更以同情心和道德应用来衡量。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: China artists quit S.Korea art show after organisers let ‘Taiwan’ be used in name of exhibition
title.zh: 中国艺术家因“台湾”参展名称退出韩国艺术展

summary.en: Chinese artists have withdrawn from a major South Korean art exhibition, the Gwangju Biennale, after organizers allowed the name "Taiwan" to be used in an exhibition title. This action has drawn criticism from China and highlights the ongoing political sensitivities surrounding cross-strait relations.
summary.zh: 中国艺术家已退出韩国光州双年展，原因是组织者允许在一场展览的名称中使用“台湾”一词。此举引发了中国的批评，并凸显了海峡两岸关系中持续存在的政治敏感性。

body.en: Chinese artists withdrew from a major South Korean art show after organisers allowed “Taiwan” to be used in the name of an exhibition, officials said Thursday, as China issued a rebuke. Gwangju Biennale. Photo: Gwangju Biennale. The Gwangju Biennale, one of Asia’s largest contemporary art events, is due to open Saturday, with its Pavilion Project bringing together artists from around the world at venues across the southwestern city. The dispute began after Taiwanese artists said organisers had initially agreed to call their exhibition the “Taiwan Pavilion”, but changed the name in June to “NTMoFA”, the acronym for Taiwan’s National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts. The change was made “without the consent of the participating team, and brutally erased Taiwan from the poster,” the artists said in a joint statement last month, accusing organisers of “political censorship”. China insists Taiwan is part of its territory and has threatened to use force to annex the self-ruled island of more than 23 million people. Last week, the Gwangju Biennale foundation reversed course and agreed to restore the name “Taiwan Pavilion”. Chinese artists then halted preparations for their own pavilion, and on Thursday, the Chinese artists announced they would formally withdraw, according to local media footage. A spokesperson for the foundation told AFP: “We have confirmation the Chinese artists are withdrawing from the biennale.” China’s consulate general in Gwangju said Biennale organisers “openly allowed the Taiwan region of China to participate in the exhibition using a name that is completely inconsistent with its status.” “This constitutes a serious violation of the One China principle,” it said, adding: “We once again urge the organisers of the Gwangju Biennale to immediately rectify their wrongdoing.” South Korea’s foreign ministry spoke up to calm the row, saying that the “government’s basic position regarding Taiwan remains unchanged”. Taiwan’s flag. Photo: Walid Berrazeg/HKFP. The ministry said the decision was made in the cultural and artistic sphere, and “is unrelated to the South Korean government’s position regarding Taiwan.” “We hope that this issue will not affect South Korea-China relations or exchanges and cooperation between the two countries,” they added.
body.zh: 官员周四表示，在组织者允许在展览名称中使用“台湾”一词后，中国艺术家退出了韩国的一场大型艺术展，中国对此予以谴责。光州双年展。照片：光州双年展。亚洲最大的当代艺术活动之一光州双年展将于周六开幕，其展馆项目将来自世界各地的艺术家聚集在这座西南部城市的各个场馆。争议始于台湾艺术家表示，主办方最初同意将他们的展览命名为“台湾馆”，但在六月将其名称改为“NTMoFA”，即台湾国立台湾美术馆的缩写。艺术家们在上个月的一份联合声明中表示，这一改变是“未经参赛团队同意的，并且残酷地将台湾从海报上抹掉”，并指责组织者进行“政治审查”。中国坚称台湾是其领土的一部分，并威胁要使用武力吞并这个拥有超过 2300 万人口的自治岛屿。上周，光州双年展基金会改变立场，同意恢复“台湾馆”名称。据当地媒体报道，中国艺术家随后停止了自己展馆的准备工作，周四，中国艺术家宣布正式退出。该基金会的发言人告诉法新社：“我们已确认中国艺术家将退出双年展。”中国驻光州总领事馆表示，双年展组织者“公然允许中国台湾地区使用与其地位完全不符的名称参加展览”。 “这严重违反了一个中国原则，”声明称，并补充说：“我们再次敦促光州双年展的组织者立即纠正错误行为。”韩国外交部发声平息争端，称“政府对台湾的基本立场没有改变”。台湾的国旗。照片：Walid Berrazeg/HKFP。韩国文化部表示，这一决定是在文化艺术领域做出的，“与韩国政府对台湾的立场无关”。他们补充说：“我们希望这个问题不会影响韩中关系或两国之间的交流与合作。”

reflection.en: The Gwangju Biennale dispute, where Chinese artists withdrew over the naming of a Taiwanese exhibition, illustrates how political sensitivities can disrupt cultural exchange. The desire for peace and harmonious relations, as urged in Romans 12:18, is challenged when nationalistic sentiments lead to withdrawal rather than dialogue.
reflection.zh: 光州双年展的争端，中国艺术家因台湾展览的命名问题而退出，说明了政治敏感性如何扰乱文化交流。罗马书12章18节所敦促的和平与和谐关系之愿望，在民族主义情绪导致退出而非对话时受到挑战。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Driver dies after Tesla collides with 2 cars on Hong Kong expressway
title.zh: 特斯拉在香港高速公路上与两车相撞后，一名司机死亡

summary.en: A driver has died after a Tesla collided with a seven-seater vehicle on Hong Kong’s Island Eastern Corridor. Police were alerted to the crash involving two private cars driving west on Saturday morning. The driver of one vehicle was taken to the hospital unconscious and later certified dead.
summary.zh: 周六上午，一辆特斯拉在香港东区走廊与一辆七人座汽车相撞后，一名司机死亡。警方接到报案，称有两辆私家车沿该走廊向西行驶时发生碰撞。其中一辆车的司机被送往医院时昏迷不醒，后被宣告死亡。

body.en: A driver has died after a Tesla collided with a seven-seater on Hong Kong’s Island Eastern Corridor. Police received a call at 10.37am on Saturday alerting them to a crash involving two private cars driving west along the corridor. The force said the driver of one private vehicle was sent to Ruttonjee Hospital in Wan Chai while unconscious. The driver was later certified dead at 12.08pm. It was not immediately clear which of the drivers died. The force said the incident remained under...
body.zh: 一辆特斯拉在香港东区走廊与一辆七座车相撞，导致一名司机死亡。周六上午 10 点 37 分，警方接到报警电话，称两辆私家车沿走廊向西行驶发生车祸。警方表示，一辆私家车的司机在不省人事的情况下被送往湾仔律敦治医院。中午12点08分，司机被证实死亡。目前尚不清楚哪些司机死亡。警方表示，事件仍在调查中...

reflection.en: The news of a fatal collision on Hong Kong's Island Eastern Corridor is a stark reminder of life's fragility. Hebrews 9:27 speaks to the universal truth that death comes to all, a moment of reckoning that awaits every person. In the face of such sudden loss, we are called to reflect on our own mortality and the preciousness of the time we are given.
reflection.zh: 香港东区走廊发生的致命车祸新闻，令人警醒地提醒我们生命的脆弱。希伯来书9章27节谈到死亡是所有人的必然结局，这是每个人最终都要面对的时刻。面对如此突然的损失，我们被呼召反思自己的必死性以及我们所拥有的时光的宝贵。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Three held, 1,600 vials seized in fake-vaccine raids
title.zh: 三名嫌疑人被捕，缴获1600支假疫苗

summary.en: Hong Kong authorities have arrested three individuals and seized over 1,600 vials of unregistered vaccines in raids on 14 locations. The vaccines were falsely advertised on social media as capable of preventing certain cancers, but investigations confirmed they did not contain the claimed efficacy. The Secretary for...
summary.zh: 香港当局在突袭14个地点后，逮捕了三名嫌疑人，并缴获了超过1600支未经注册的疫苗。这些疫苗在社交媒体上被虚假宣传为能够预防某些癌症，但调查证实它们并未包含所声称的功效。卫生局局长卢宠茂强调了此次行动在打击此类欺诈性健康宣传方面的成功。

body.en: Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau said on Saturday that more than 1,600 vials of unregistered vaccines had been seized during raids on 14 premises. However, none of the vials contained vaccines that were touted by a health centre on social media in July as capable of preventing the Wilms' tumor 1 (WT1) and other cancers. Three people who were in charge of the premises were arrested during the joint operation by the police and the Department of Health, with Lo saying one of them was a doctor. The operation came amid growing concern that several health centres were claiming to offer a vaccine for the WTI cancer that affects children's kidneys, leading to the Department of Health to stress there is no such pharmaceutical product registered in Hong Kong, on the mainland or overseas. Lo warned that administering unregistered vaccines poses severe health risks. "Although these vials may not be WT1-related, they could contain vitamins or so-called anti-ageing products," he said. "However, when injected, if it isn't registered it is extremely dangerous because it goes directly into the body; it's not taken orally, but administered directly into the bloodstream," he told an RTHK radio programme. "There have been previous instances where using these so-called health products caused bacteria to enter the bloodstream because they were contaminated." Lo added that, to date, there have been no reports of people having received the so-called WT1 vaccine. Edited by Azam Khan
body.zh: 卫生部长卢仲茂周六表示，在突击检查 14 个场所时，检获了 1,600 多瓶未经注册的疫苗。然而，这些小瓶中没有一个含有健康中心7月份在社交媒体上宣传的能够预防威尔姆斯氏瘤1（WT1）和其他癌症的疫苗。警方与卫生署联合行动，拘捕该处所的三名负责人，罗说其中一名是医生。此次行动的背景是，人们越来越担心几家医疗中心声称提供一种针对影响儿童肾脏的 WTI 癌症的疫苗，导致卫生署强调，在香港、内地或海外都没有此类药品注册。罗警告说，注射未经注册的疫苗会带来严重的健康风险。 “虽然这些小瓶可能与 WT1 无关，但它们可能含有维生素或所谓的抗衰老产品，”他说。他在香港电台电台节目中表示：“然而，注射时，如果没有登记，就会极其危险，因为它会直接进入体内；它不是口服的，而是直接进入血液。” “以前曾有过使用这些所谓的保健品导致细菌进入血液的情况，因为它们被污染了。” Lo补充说，迄今为止，还没有关于人们接种所谓的WT1疫苗的报告。阿扎姆·汗编辑

reflection.en: The pursuit of health and healing is a deep human need, yet it can be exploited by those driven by greed. The actions of the Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau in cracking down on these unregistered vaccines demonstrate a commitment to justice and protecting the vulnerable. This echoes the prophet Micah’s call for leaders to "act justly and to love mercy and...
reflection.zh: 追求健康和治愈是人类深切的需求，但它也可能被贪婪者所利用。卫生局局长卢宠茂打击这些未经注册疫苗的行动，展现了对公正和保护弱势群体的承诺。这呼应了先知弥迦的呼吁：要“施行公平，喜爱慈爱，谦卑地与你的雅伟同行。”

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Police nab three over seditious acts
title.zh: 警方以煽动罪拘捕三人

summary.en: National security police arrested three individuals, aged between 33 and 79, on Thursday on suspicion of committing acts with seditious intent. The arrests followed allegations that the trio shouted seditious slogans and spread false information outside the MTR Prince Edward station on August 31, with the stated...
summary.zh: 国家安全警察于周四以涉嫌怀有煽动意图并作出煽动行为为由，拘捕了三名年龄介于33至79岁的人士。此次行动是在该三人于8月31日在港铁太子站外手持鲜花时，涉嫌喊出煽动性口号并散布虚假信息后进行的。警方表示，他们的意图是煽动对香港特区政府及执法部门的仇恨。

body.en: National security police have arrested three people on suspicion of "doing an act that has a seditious intention with a seditious intention". The operation on Thursday came as the trio – aged between 33 and 79 – allegedly shouted seditious slogans when they were standing outside MTR Prince Edward station holding bouquets on August 31. “The persons concerned were suspected of spreading false information and attacking the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (HKSAR) Government with lies, as well as smearing the Police Force, with the intention of inciting hatred against the HKSAR Government and law enforcement agencies,” a statement read. Police obtained court search warrants prior to the operation to search their residences and seize relevant exhibits. Police stressed that the so-called "831 incident" has been proven without factual basis. It is a lie manipulated by persons with ulterior motives to spread lies, attack the HKSAR Government and smear the Police Force, attempting to achieve their political objectives by endangering public peace. Edited by Azam Khan
body.zh: 国安警察以涉嫌“具有煽动煽动意图的行为”逮捕了三人。周四的行动发生时，这三人年龄介乎33岁至79岁，据称于8月31日手持花束站在港铁太子站外时高喊煽动性口号。声明称，“涉案人员涉嫌散布虚假信息、用谎言攻击香港特别行政区政府，以及抹黑警队，意图煽动对香港特别行政区政府和执法机构的仇恨。”警方在行动前获得法庭搜查令，搜查他们的住所并扣押相关证物。警方强调，所谓“831事件”已被证实没有事实依据。这是别有用心的人操纵的谎言，散布谎言，攻击特区政府，抹黑警队，企图以危害社会治安来达到自己的政治目的。阿扎姆·汗编辑

reflection.en: The arrests in Hong Kong highlight the tension between state authority and freedom of expression. When laws or government actions compel citizens to act against their conscience or deeply held beliefs, the question arises: to whom is ultimate allegiance owed? The ancient principle remains: 'We must obey God rather than human beings.'
reflection.zh: 香港的此次逮捕事件凸显了国家权力与言论自由之间的紧张关系。当法律或政府行为迫使公民违背良心或其根深蒂固的信念时，一个问题便浮现出来：最终的效忠对象是谁？古老的原则依然适用：“我们必须服从雅伟，而不是人。”

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Airport scare as display dangles in mid-air after fall
title.zh: 机场惊魂：显示屏坠落悬空

summary.en: An overhead electronic display at Hong Kong International Airport's Terminal 2 fell approximately seven meters on Saturday, leaving it dangling in mid-air. Fortunately, no one was injured as the marine-themed display landed eight meters above the ground. The incident is believed to have been caused by a steel cable...
summary.zh: 周六，香港国际机场二号客运大楼的一个架空电子显示屏坠落约七米，悬挂在半空中。幸运的是，该海洋主题的显示屏最终停在离地面八米处，无人受伤。事故据信是钢缆断裂所致，机场管理局表示显示屏的坠落制动系统已启动。

body.en: An overhead electronic display at Hong Kong International Airport’s Terminal 2 was left dangling in mid-air after falling about seven metres on Saturday. No one was injured as the marine-themed display ended up eight metres above ground after falling from its original 15-metre-high perch. Police said they were alerted at around 8.30 am about the incident involving the 1.5m by 1.5m installation and that there was no immediate danger. Firefighters were on standby at the scene. In a social media post, the Airport Authority said the installation's fall-arrest system came into play during the malfunction and that the area was immediately cordoned off. A maintenance team has further stabilised the installation, the authority said, adding that it would conduct a thorough investigation into the cause of the incident to further enhance the stability of the safety system. "Airport Authority Hong Kong takes the incident very seriously and will conduct a detailed investigation into the cause of the incident, with view to further enhancing the stability of the system." Edited by Robert Kemp _____________________________ Last updated: 2026-09-05 HKT 16:05
body.zh: 周六，香港国际机场二号航站楼的一个电子显示屏从高空坠落约七米后悬在半空中。这座以海洋为主题的展览从原来 15 米高的位置坠落，最终坠落到距地面 8 米的地方，没有人受伤，原因据信是一根钢缆脱落。警方表示，他们于上午 8.30 左右接到有关涉及 1.5m x 1.5m 装置的事件的警报，但没有立即发生危险。消防人员在现场待命。机场管理局在社交媒体帖子中表示，该装置的防坠落系统在故障期间发挥了作用，该地区立即被封锁。当局表示，维修小组已进一步稳定了装置，并补充说，将彻底调查事故原因，以进一步增强安全系统的稳定性。声明称：“机场管理局对事件深表关注，并将彻底调查事件原因。”罗伯特·坎普编辑

reflection.en: This incident at Hong Kong International Airport, where a large display unexpectedly fell, serves as a reminder of the importance of careful work and maintenance. Even in busy, modern environments, the integrity of structures and systems relies on diligent attention to detail. Colossians 3:23 encourages us to do all our work heartily, as if for Yahweh,...
reflection.zh: 香港国际机场发生的这个大型显示屏意外坠落的事件，提醒我们细致工作和维护的重要性。即使在繁忙的现代化环境中，结构和系统的完整性也依赖于对细节的勤勉关注。歌罗西书3章23节鼓励我们凡事都从心里做，像是为主做的，这体现了一种超越基本要求的严谨标准。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Po Pin Chau real-name trial debuts with 1,500 bookings
title.zh: 蒲台岛实名预约试行首日吸引1500人登记

summary.en: On Saturday, approximately 1,500 individuals registered for the Po Pin Chau trail in Sai Kung East Country Park during the inaugural day of a real-name reservation trial. The system allows up to 500 visitors per two-hour slot, with a daily cap of 2,000, requiring bookings via Klook with verified real names. The trial...
summary.zh: 官员周六表示，在西贡东郊野公园蒲台岛行山径实名预约试行首日，约有1500人登记。该计划规定，每两个小时时段最多接待500名访客，每日上限为2000人。访客必须通过Klook平台使用真实姓名进行预约，并在抵达时进行核实。试行期涵盖九月所有周末，其中最后一个周末恰逢中秋节，以及十月的国庆黄金周。

body.en: Officials on Saturday said about 1,500 people registered to visit the Po Pin Chau trail in Sai Kung East Country Park on the first day of a real-name reservation trial. Under the scheme, up to 500 visitors are admitted during each two-hour slot, with the daily number capped at 2,000. Visitors must book via the Klook platform using their real name, which will be verified upon arrival. The trial covers all weekends in September, the last of which coincides with the Mid-Autumn Festival, as well as the National Day Golden Week in October. Director of Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Mickey Lai said operations were smooth on the opening day. "Especially because it’s the first day, we set up some information centres, and we're doing our best to manage crowd flows," he said. "Today's turnout is normal and similar to what we've seen in the past. We will continue to monitor crowd flow every weekend, paying particular attention during the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day Golden Week holidays." Lai added that walk-in visitors were admitted because some reservation slots were unfilled. A tourist from Suzhou, who made the booking two days ago, found the arrangement to be more suitable. “I saw comments online saying that photos might not turn out well with too many people around. Spreading out the crowds is better and more reasonable," she said. Edited by Robert Kemp _____________________________ Last updated: 2026-09-05 HKT 15:07
body.zh: 官员周六表示，西贡东郊野公园破边洲步道实行实名预约试行首日，已有约 1,500 人登记参观。根据该计划，每两小时最多可容纳 500 名游客，每日入场人数上限为 2,000 人。游客必须通过Klook客路平台使用真实姓名进行预订，抵达时将进行验证。此次试点涵盖9月份的所有周末，其中最后一个周末恰逢中秋节，以及10月份的国庆黄金周。渔农自然护理署署长黎伟明表示，开幕当日运作顺利。 “特别是因为这是第一天，我们设立了一些信息中心，我们正在尽最大努力管理人流，”他说。 “今天的投票率很正常，与过去的情况类似。我们将继续监控每个周末的人流情况，特别是中秋节和国庆黄金周假期期间。”赖补充说，由于一些预约名额未满，因此允许直接入场的游客入场。前两天预订的苏州游客觉得这样的安排比较合适。 “我看到网上有评论说，人太多的话，照片拍出来的效果可能会不好。分散人群比较好，也比较合理。”她说。编辑：Robert Kemp _____________________________ 最后更新：2026-09-05 HKT 15:07

reflection.en: The launch of the Po Pin Chau trail's real-name reservation system marks a new phase in managing visitor access to natural spaces. This careful planning and execution, involving technology and public cooperation, reflects a commitment to order and accessibility. May all such endeavors be committed to Yahweh, trusting in His guidance for their success and...
reflection.zh: 蒲台岛行山径实名预约系统的推出，标志着管理游客进入自然空间的新阶段。这种周密的规划和执行，涉及技术和公众的合作，体现了对秩序和可达性的承诺。愿所有此类努力都奉献给雅伟，信靠祂的指引，以求成功并造福社群。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: HKFP Lens: ‘Love at last sight’ – bidding farewell to Hong Kong’s modernist General Post Office after 50 years
title.zh: HKFP镜头：“最后的凝视之爱”——告别香港50年的现代主义邮政总局

summary.en: When Hong Kong's General Post Office was constructed in Central fifty years ago, conservationists lamented the demolition of the building it replaced. The former General Post Office was an architectural masterpiece of the Edwardian era, featuring grand archways and granite veranda pillars under a distinctive facade of...
summary.zh: 五十年前，当香港邮政总局在香港岛中环建成时，保育人士对它取代的旧建筑被拆毁感到惋惜。旧邮政总局是一座爱德华时代建筑的杰作，拥有宏伟的拱门和花岗岩门廊柱，以及独特的玫瑰色厦门砖外墙，这被认为是抵御南中国海岸风暴的耐用性标杆。邮政总局位于干诺道2号的底层入口。十多年前，香港历史博物馆前总馆长曾称赞它为“香港最美丽的建筑”。

body.en: When the General Post Office was built in Central half a century ago, conservationists mourned the loss of the building it replaced. Exterior of the General Post Office. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The old General Post Office was a marvel of Edwardian architecture: sweeping archways and granite veranda pillars beneath a distinctive façade of rose-coloured Amoy brick – the gold standard for durability on the storm-lashed South China coast. The GPO’s ground-floor entrance at 2 Connaught Place. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Just over a decade ago, the former chief curator of the Hong Kong Museum of History crowned it “Hong Kong’s most beautiful building” when it stood at the site of what is now World-Wide House. For others , its loss ranked alongside the demolition of the old Hong Kong Club as one of the greatest architectural crimes the city has committed against itself. Post Office Private Boxes on the second floor of the GPO. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. But fast-forward to 2026 and accolades are now pouring in for the much-maligned replacement structure. Ahead of its own demolition, the current modernist General Post Office, erected in 1976, is belatedly finding recognition as an icon of modern Hong Kong heritage. Service counters in the General Post Office. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Crouching just five storeys above the Central harbourfront – its planned stature stunted so as to preserve the sea view from Jardine House – the post office’s sharp lines and white concrete walls buck against its ornate predecessor. Customers queue in the main hall of the GPO. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Yet, in retrospect, it’s clear to see how these design choices reflected the society it was born into: one that, by the 1970s, prized simple, utilitarian structures that served a rapidly growing population first and foremost. In the headlong rush to modernise and develop, form followed function – and decoration was optional. Towers of parcels wait at a GPO counter. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. It’s not the first time a modern landmark has, with time, won the hearts of Hongkongers. A row of desks in the GPO. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The looming demise of the GPO’s erstwhile neighbour, Edinburgh Place Ferry Pier, sparked spirited protests and a sit-in by conservationists in 2006. Although they failed to protect the 1950s landmark, many saw the movement as a watershed moment that led to the localist movement and pro-democracy mobilisation of the 2010s. A stairwell inside the GPO. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. In North Point, efforts to save the mid-century State Theatre have been ongoing for a decade, with some hard-won concessions from the government and developers. A second-floor window in the GPO overlooks the Court of Final Appeal Building....
body.zh: 半个世纪前，当邮政总局在中环建成时，自然资源保护主义者对它所取代的建筑物的损失表示哀悼。邮政总局的外观。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。旧邮政总局是爱德华时代建筑的奇迹：宽阔的拱门和花岗岩阳台柱子位于独特的玫瑰色厦门砖外墙之下，这是暴风雨肆虐的华南海岸耐用性的黄金标准。 GPO 底层入口位于康诺特广场 2 号。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。就在十多年前，当它矗立在现在的环球大厦旧址时，香港历史博物馆前总馆长将其誉为“香港最美丽的建筑”。对于其他人来说，它的损失与拆除旧香港会一样，是这座城市对自己犯下的最大的建筑罪行之一。邮局私人信箱位于 GPO 二楼。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。但快进到 2026 年，备受诟病的替代结构获得的赞誉纷至沓来。建于 1976 年的现代主义风格的邮政总局在被拆除之前，后来才被认为是现代香港遗产的象征。邮政总局的服务柜台。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。邮局坐落在中环海滨上方仅五层楼高处，其规划的高度被限制，以保留怡和大厦的海景。邮局的锐利线条和白色混凝土墙与其华丽的前身形成鲜明对比。顾客在 GPO 大厅排队。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。然而，回想起来，我们可以清楚地看到这些设计选择如何反映了它诞生的社会：到了 20 世纪 70 年代，这个社会推崇简单、实用的结构，首先是为快速增长的人口服务。在现代化和发展的急速推进中，形式追随功能——装饰是可选的。 GPO 柜台前堆满了包裹。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。随着时间的推移，现代地标赢得了香港人的心，这并不是第一次。 GPO 中的一排办公桌。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 2006 年，GPO 的昔日邻居爱丁堡广场渡轮码头即将消亡，引发了自然资源保护主义者的激烈抗议和静坐。尽管他们未能保护 1950 年代的地标，但许多人认为这场运动是导致 2010 年代地方主义运动和民主动员的分水岭。 GPO 内的楼梯间。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。在北角，拯救中世纪国家剧院的努力已经持续了十年，政府和开发商做出了一些来之不易的让步。总督察署二楼的一扇窗户俯瞰着终审法院大楼……

reflection.en: For fifty years, the General Post Office building stood in Central, a landmark that has now reached the end of its public service life. The story notes the lament of conservationists for the beautiful Edwardian building it replaced, highlighting the passage of time and the inevitable changes that come with it. Ecclesiastes reminds us that 'there is a time...
reflection.zh: 五十年来，邮政总局大楼矗立在中环，如今它已走到了公众服务生涯的尽头。故事提到保育人士对它取代的爱德华时代美丽建筑的惋惜，突显了时间的流逝以及随之而来的不可避免的变化。《传道书》提醒我们，“凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时”，这是建筑物的兴衰和城市发展的变迁所体现的真理。

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verse.textZh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。

title.en: Ruth Wang, Chinese lawyer for underground church, flees to Taiwan – rights group
title.zh: 中国地下教会律师王瑞德逃往台湾——人权组织

summary.en: Taiwan has offered temporary shelter to a Chinese citizen, identified by a rights group as Ruth Wang, a lawyer representing detained leaders of Beijing's underground Zion Church. Wang reportedly arrived in Taiwan seeking protection from authorities.
summary.zh: 台湾已为一名中国公民提供临时住所，该公民被一个权利组织确认为王瑞德律师。王律师曾代理北京地下教会锡安教会被拘留的领袖。据报道，王律师于周三抵达台湾，寻求当局的保护。

body.en: Taiwan said Friday it has provided “temporary accommodation” to a Chinese citizen, after a rights group reported that a lawyer representing detained leaders of an underground church in Beijing had fled to the island. Ruth Wang. Photo: Ruth Wang. Taiwan’s top China policy body did not identify the person, but ChinaAid said Ruth Wang, a partner at Vdoor Law Firm in Beijing, had arrived in Taiwan on Wednesday “seeking protection from Taiwanese authorities”. ChinaAid said Wang was a lawyer for detained leaders of Zion Church, one of China’s unregistered churches that some Christians choose to worship at instead of state-sanctioned ones regulated by the government. “Wang and her family left China because of concerns about increasing government pressure related to her legal work and representation of detained Beijing Zion Church leaders,” ChinaAid said on Thursday, citing information it had obtained and reporting by the Associated Press news agency. Taiwan’s Mainland Affairs Council issued a brief statement on Friday in response to media reports about a “Chinese lawyer seeking assistance in Taiwan”. It said the government has provided a “Chinese national transferring through a Taiwanese airport” with “temporary accommodation on humanitarian grounds and is following up on the matter”. Members of the Zion Church, including the founder Ezra Jin, were detained in October on “suspicion of the illegal use of information networks”. China released Jin, also known by his Chinese name Mingri, in July after US President Donald Trump raised his case with Xi Jinping. Photo: X. Eight of the Zion Church members detained in October are still being held, ChinaAid said. China’s ruling Communist Party has historically regarded organised religion with suspicion, and under Xi has tightened scrutiny of unofficial groups. Authorities have been cracking down on unregistered churches in recent months.
body.zh: 台湾周五表示，已为一名中国公民提供“临时住所”，此前一个人权组织报道称，一名代表北京地下教会被拘留领导人的律师已逃往台湾。王露丝.照片：王露丝。台湾最高的中国政策机构没有透露此人的身份，但对华援助协会表示，北京Vdoor律师事务所合伙人王露丝已于周三抵达台湾“寻求台湾当局的保护”。对华援助协会表示，王是锡安教会被拘留领导人的律师，锡安教会是中国未注册的教会之一，一些基督徒选择在该教会做礼拜，而不是政府监管的国家认可的教会。对华援助协会周四援引其获得的信息和美联社的报道称，“王和她的家人离开中国是因为担心政府在她的法律工作和代表被拘留的北京锡安教会领袖方面施加的压力越来越大。”台湾陆委会周五发表简短声明，回应媒体有关“中国律师在台寻求援助”的报道。声明称，政府已“出于人道主义理由为一名通过台湾机场转机的中国公民提供临时住宿，并正在跟进此事”。锡安教会成员，包括创始人Ezra Jin，于10月因“涉嫌非法利用信息网络”被拘留。在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普向习近平提出此事后，中国于 7 月释放了金明日。对华援助协会表示，10 月份被拘留的 8 名锡安教会成员仍被关押。中国执政的共产党历来对有组织的宗教持怀疑态度，在习近平的领导下，加强了对非官方团体的审查。近几个月来，当局一直在打击未注册的教堂。

reflection.en: The news of Ruth Wang, a lawyer who represented an underground church and has fled China seeking protection, highlights the courage of those who advocate for religious freedom. Her actions echo the biblical call to speak for the voiceless and defend the rights of the oppressed, even at great personal risk. May her pursuit of safety find peace and her...
reflection.zh: 王瑞德律师曾代理地下教会，现已逃离中国寻求庇护，这一消息凸显了那些倡导宗教自由者的勇气。她的行为呼应了圣经中为无声者发声、为受压迫者辩护的呼召，即使这会带来巨大的个人风险。愿她寻求安全的过程能获得平安，她的倡导能激励他人。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Jockey Club suspends highly anticipated mainland race, citing new risk assessment from Chinese authorities
title.zh: 赛马会因中国当局新风险评估暂停备受期待的内地赛事

summary.en: The Hong Kong Jockey Club (HKJC) has suspended a highly anticipated horse racing event scheduled for mainland China, citing a new risk assessment from Chinese authorities. The event, planned for the HKJC Conghua Racecourse in Guangzhou, was intended to be the club's first racecourse on the Chinese mainland.
summary.zh: 香港赛马会（HKJC）已暂停一项原定在中国内地举行的备受期待的赛马赛事，理由是中国当局的一项新风险评估。该赛事原定在香港赛马会从化马场举行，这将是该马会在中国内地的首个赛马场。

body.en: The Hong Kong Jockey Club (HKJC) has suspended a highly anticipated horse racing event due to be held in mainland China, citing a new risk assessment from mainland authorities. HKJC Conghua Racecourse. Photo: HKJC. Following its annual general meeting, the HKJC said in a statement on Wednesday that the scheduled race meeting would be postponed to an unspecified date. In November last year, HKJC CEO Winfried Engelbrecht-Bresges said in an interview that the club would stage a world-class horse racing event at its Conghua Racecourse in Guangzhou – the club’s first racecourse in the Chinese mainland. The meeting had been scheduled for October 31, and was expected to feature five to six races. Engelbrecht-Bresges said the inaugural meeting would only be attended by officials and invited guests. “The second meeting, which will be at the end of November, will be the first real launch for everyone,” Engelbrecht-Bresges added. “It will be the launch of world-class racing in mainland China.” People witness the exhibition race day in the Conghua Racecourse in March, 2019. Photo: HKJC. According to the HKJC statement, the club “very recently received [the] latest risk assessment from the relevant Mainland departments.” “Following discussions between both parties,” the statement read, “it was agreed that we will continue to work closely together to devise appropriate mitigation measures.” It added that the HKJC has long been working with mainland Chinese authorities to fulfil “all necessary statutory and procedural requirements” for the event. Surprise cancellation Local media reported that the cancellation came as a shock to HKJC members. The Conghua Racecourse was first opened in 2018. In March 2019, the HKJC held an exhibition race day, which saw Hong Kong horses and jockeys compete in the mainland for the first time. VIPs included Hong Kong’s then-chief executive Carrie Lam, then-director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office Zhang Xiaoming, and then-governor of Guangdong Ma Xingrui. Carrie Lam, then-chief executive of Hong Kong, attends the exhibition race day of Conghua Racecourse in March 2019 and delivers a speech. Photo: HKJC. The Jockey Club, founded in 1884, holds a government-granted monopoly on betting in horseracing and football in Hong Kong. In April this year, the Hong Kong government announced it would suspend plans to legalise basketball betting, citing concerns about the rapid growth of prediction markets.
body.zh: 香港赛马会（HKJC）以内地当局的新风险评估为由，暂停了原定在中国内地举行的备受期待的赛马赛事。香港赛马会从化马场。照片：香港赛马会。香港赛马会在年度股东大会结束后于周三发表声明称，原定的赛马大会将推迟至具体日期。去年11月，马会行政总裁温弗里德在接受采访时表示，马会将在广州从化马场举办世界级赛马赛事，这是马会在中国内地的首个马场。会议原定于 10 月 31 日举行，预计将进行五到六场比赛。恩格尔布雷希特-布雷热表示，首次会议将只有官员和受邀嘉宾参加。 “第二次会议将于 11 月底举行，这将是每个人的第一次真正的启动，”Engelbrecht-Bresges 补充道。 “这将是世界级赛车运动在中国大陆的启动。” 2019年3月，人们在从化马场见证表演赛日。照片：香港赛马会。根据香港赛马会的声明，马会“最近收到了内地有关部门的最新风险评估”。声明中写道：“经过双方讨论，我们同意我们将继续密切合作，制定适当的缓解措施。”它补充说，香港赛马会长期以来一直与中国内地当局合作，以满足赛事的“所有必要的法定和程序要求”。意外取消 当地媒体报道称，取消令马会会员感到震惊。从化马场于2018年首次启用。2019年3月，香港赛马会举办表演赛日，香港马匹和骑师首次在内地比赛。贵宾包括时任香港特首林郑月娥、时任港澳事务办公室主任张晓明、时任广东省省长马兴瑞。 2019年3月，时任香港特首林郑月娥出席从化马场表演赛日并致辞。照片：香港赛马会。赛马会成立于1884年，拥有政府授予的香港赛马和足球博彩垄断权。今年4月，香港政府宣布将暂停篮球博彩合法化计划，理由是对预测市场快速增长的担忧。

reflection.en: The Hong Kong Jockey Club's decision to postpone its mainland race meeting, based on a new risk assessment from Chinese authorities, underscores the unpredictable nature of large-scale projects. It is a reminder that even well-laid plans must ultimately be committed to a higher wisdom and providence, acknowledging that outcomes are not solely within human...
reflection.zh: 香港赛马会因中国当局的一项新风险评估而决定推迟其内地赛事，这凸显了大型项目不可预测的性质。这提醒我们，即使是精心策划的计划，最终也必须托付于更高的智慧和天意，并认识到结果并非完全在人类的掌控之中。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong, a young activist known for his role in Hong Kong's democracy movement, has pleaded guilty to charges under the national security law. This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Shein shares slide on fast-fashion retailer’s stock market debut
title.zh: Shein股票上市首日下跌，快时尚零售商估值缩水

summary.en: Shares of the fast-fashion brand Shein fell as much as 10% on their debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The company, founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, was valued at just over $26 billion, a significant drop from its previous valuation of nearly $100 billion.
summary.zh: 快时尚品牌Shein在香港证券交易所上市首日股价下跌高达10%。这家中国创立、现总部设在新加坡的公司，估值略高于260亿美元，远低于其此前近1000亿美元的估值。

body.en: Hong Kong flotation at $26bn by firm once valued at $100bn follows failure to list in US and UK Shares in the fast-fashion brand Shein slumped by as much as 10% as the China-founded company made its long-anticipated trading debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The Singapore-headquartered company, once valued at almost $100bn (£74bn), went public on Tuesday pricing shares at HK$48.56, valuing the business at just over $26bn. Continue reading...
body.zh: 曾估值 1000 亿美元的公司在香港发行 260 亿美元，此前该公司未能在美国和英国上市。快时尚品牌 Shein 在香港证券交易所首次上市后，其股价下跌了 10%。这家总部位于新加坡的公司一度估值近 1000 亿美元（740 亿英镑），周二上市，股价为 48.56 港元，业务估值略高于 260 亿美元。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic drop in Shein's valuation on its Hong Kong stock market debut, from nearly $100 billion to just over $26 billion, serves as a potent reminder of the volatile nature of commerce. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans, a wisdom that transcends market highs and lows.

title.en: The London stock market dodged a bullet with Shein | Nils Pratley
title.zh: 希音避开伦敦股市，转投香港上市

summary.en: Shein, the Chinese fast-fashion giant, has decided to list its shares in Hong Kong instead of London, despite political efforts in the UK to attract the company. The company's valuation has also been reduced, and questions remain about its business model.
summary.zh: 这家中国快时尚巨头希音（Shein）已决定在香港上市，而非伦敦，尽管英国政界曾努力吸引该公司。该公司的估值也有所缩水，其商业模式仍存疑问。

body.en: China’s fashion giant will list in Hong Kong with a shrunken price tag – and big questions over its business model In a parallel world, we might now be preparing for the arrival on the London stock market of Shein, the giant Chinese-founded fast-fashion retailer. Or it could have happened already. The possibility of a London flotation was a running story during 2024 and into last year as politicians from both main parties engaged in behind-the-scenes wooing. Shein was seen as a shot of tech adrenalin for a listless local listings scene, and an opportunity to advertise the UK’s openness to international capital. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国时尚巨头将以更低的价格在香港上市——其商业模式面临重大疑问在另一个平行世界中，我们现在可能正在为中国创办的大型快时尚零售商 Shein 登陆伦敦股市做准备。或者它可能已经发生了。 2024 年和去年，随着两个主要政党的政治家都在幕后拉拢，在伦敦上市的可能性一直是一个热门话题。 Shein 被视为为当地无精打采的上市场景注入一剂科技肾上腺素，也是宣传英国对国际资本开放的机会。继续阅读...

Proverbs 16:3 reminds us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans. This principle encourages seeking divine guidance in all our work, whether personal or corporate, ensuring our efforts align with...

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? When laws compel silence on historical truths, the call to obey God rather than human authorities becomes a vital principle for conscience.

title.en: Late Roman decrees uncover military system behind amphitheater animal spectacles
title.zh: 晚期罗马法令揭示圆形剧场动物奇观背后的军事体系

summary.en: A study on Roman law by the Carlos III University of Madrid analyzes the regulations and complex imperial logistics governing the capture, transport and safety of animals used in spectacles in the Roman Empire—which were far more popular than gladiatorial combat.
summary.zh: 马德里卡洛斯三世大学的一项关于罗马法律的研究，分析了罗马帝国时期用于圆形剧场表演的动物的捕获、运输和安全规定及复杂的帝国后勤管理——这些表演比角斗士比赛更受欢迎。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A study on Roman law by the Carlos III University of Madrid analyzes the regulations and complex imperial logistics governing the capture, transport and safety of animals used in spectacles in the Roman Empire—which were far more popular than gladiatorial combat.

Behind the fascination and fervor aroused by the venationes—the hunts and exhibitions of exotic animals in Roman amphitheaters—lay a sophisticated and complex military and administrative apparatus. A study by UC3M analyzes the legal dimensions of these spectacles based on two laws from the late empire, specifically two imperial constitutions from the Theodosian Code.

The study, published in the Revista General de Derecho Romano , provides new insights into entertainment in ancient Rome, including a possible imperial monopoly on lion hunting and the abuses and security conflicts caused during the transport of wild beasts.

Through the study of the imperial constitutions preserved in the Theodosian Code (Codex Theodosianus) and later compiled in the Justinian Code (Codex Iustinianus), the research demonstrates how imperial power exercised strict control over exotic animals.

"In late antiquity, faced with the growing scarcity of big cats, a state monopoly on lions was established to guarantee the supply of animals for the emperor's spectacles and to prevent competition from private individuals—in other words, all lions belonged to the emperor," comments the study's author, Rosa María Carreño Sánchez, a researcher at the Lucio Anneo Séneca Institute of Classical Studies at UC3M.

The Roman army had highly specialized units (such as soldiers designated ad leones, the ursuarii or the vestigiatores) dedicated to tracking, capturing and guarding wild beasts along the Roman Empire's borders.

Furthermore, transporting these animals to the capital or the imperial menageries created significant logistical and economic challenges. The provinces were required to supply transport personnel at the expense of local coffers, which could lead to fraudulent practices—specifically, undue delays that not only ruined cities but could also conceal the fraudulent use of the animals for unauthorized private spectacles. To curb these abuses, the imperial administration imposed severe fines in gold on military commanders who failed to comply.

Unlike gladiatorial combat—which gradually died out because of Christianity's moral condemnation and the high cost of organizing it—the venationes survived for centuries, becoming displays of human dominion over nature and the grandeur of imperial power.

This massive phenomenon spread throughout...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 马德里卡洛斯三世大学对罗马法的一项研究分析了罗马帝国用于表演的动物的捕获、运输和安全的法规和复杂的帝国后勤——这比角斗士更受欢迎。 venationes——在罗马圆形剧场中狩猎和展示珍奇动物——所引发的迷恋和热情的背后，隐藏着一个精密而复杂的军事和行政机构。卡三大学的一项研究根据帝国晚期的两项法律，特别是《狄奥多西法典》中的两部帝国宪法，分析了这些奇观的法律维度。 这项研究发表在《Revista General de Derecho Romano》上，为古罗马的娱乐活动提供了新的见解，包括帝国可能对狮子狩猎的垄断以及在野生动物运输过程中造成的虐待和安全冲突。 通过对《狄奥多西法典》（Codex Theodosianus）和后来编入《查士丁尼法典》（Codex Iustinianus）的帝国宪法的研究，揭示了帝国权力如何对珍稀动物实行严格的控制。 “在古代晚期，面对大型猫科动物的日益稀缺，国家对狮子建立了垄断，以保证皇帝观赏所需的动物供应，并防止私人竞争——换句话说，所有狮子都属于皇帝，”该研究的作者、卡三马大学卢西奥·安内奥·塞内卡古典研究所的研究员罗莎·玛丽亚·卡雷尼奥·桑切斯评论道。 罗马军队拥有高度专业化的部队（例如被称为“ad leones”、“ursuarii”或“vestigiatores”的士兵），专门负责追踪、捕捉和看守罗马帝国边境的野兽。 此外，将这些动物运输到首都或帝国动物园带来了巨大的后勤和经济挑战。各省被要求以当地财政为代价来提供运输人员，这可能会导致欺诈行为，特别是不当延误，不仅会毁掉城市，而且还可能掩盖将动物用于未经授权的私人表演的欺诈行为。为了遏制这些违法行为，帝国政府对不遵守规定的军事指挥官处以严厉的黄金罚款。 角斗术由于基督教的道德谴责和组织成本高昂而逐渐消亡，而角斗术则不同，角斗术存活了几个世纪，成为人类对自然的统治和帝国权力的宏伟的展示。 这个巨大的现象传遍了整个...

reflection.en: The Roman Empire's elaborate system for its animal spectacles, detailed in late decrees, reveals a sophisticated administrative apparatus. This reminds us that even in pursuits of entertainment, the principles of justice and ethical governance, as Micah 6:8 calls for, should guide how systems are built and managed, ensuring fairness and accountability.
reflection.zh: 罗马帝国为动物表演建立的复杂体系，通过晚期法令得以揭示，这背后是一个精密的行政管理系统。这提醒我们，即使在追求娱乐的活动中，也应遵循雅伟所呼召的公义和道德治理原则来建立和管理系统，确保公平与问责。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Flourishing green communities are changing lives
title.zh: 蓬勃发展的绿色社区正在改变生活

summary.en: Four projects have been nominated in the environmental category in Devon's Make a Difference Awards for their work in making communities more eco-friendly, wilder, and healthier through activities like planting trees, growing vegetables, and leading nature exploration.
summary.zh: 在德文郡的“做出改变奖”环保类别中，有四个项目因其在使社区更环保、更野性、更健康方面所做的工作而获得提名，这些项目通过植树、种植蔬菜和组织自然探索等活动来达成目标。

body.en:
Four projects have been nominated in the environmental category in BBC Radio Devon's Make a Difference Awards.

The Growing Well Garden in Bow, the Sampford Peverell Tree Wardens in mid-Devon, Shallowford Farm on Dartmoor, and Sustainable Hatherleigh are being recognised for making their communities more eco-friendly, wilder and healthier.

They are doing this in a range of ways from planting trees and growing vegetables, to leading bug hunts and rediscovering nature.

The winners of the Make a Difference awards are due to be announced on 24 September at Buckfast Abbey.

Growing Well Garden is part of a green social prescribing project, where gardening is used as a therapeutic tool and helps a doctor connect with her patients in a different way.

Dr Susan Taheri is an NHS GP at Bow Medical Practice and the founder of Growing Well Garden project - she said the scheme reignited her passion for being a GP.

She said meeting patients in a garden can have benefits compared to seeing them a consulting room and describes the garden as her "happy place".

"There's a lot more getting your hands dirty and not worrying too much about germs," she said.

Retired horticulturalist Charles Staniland's love for the outdoors started in early childhood and he now volunteers there, teaching young people to get their hands dirty.

He said he wanted to show a more physical approach to food, that it doesn't just show up on a plate, and that it's something they can contribute to.

Staniland hopes the project can "encourage a new generation to understand and value the world around them".

"It takes people out of a concrete environment - it's a very good first step into a greener environment," he said.

Sampford Peverell Tree Wardens are an independent, environmentally-focused, volunteer based group which takes care of the parish's greenery.

For Pete Drew and the other wardens, looking after the environment is a community effort, often powered by cake.

The group plants, protects and maintains trees and hedges on publicly owned land, working with councils and landowners.

He said it was about "taking pride in where you live and making local spaces better for everyone".

Sustainable Hatherleigh runs a range of projects to support the community, from leading bug hunts and encouraging wildflowers and biodiversity in the local graveyard to community composting and running a repair café.

Their site in the middle of the town has now been recognised as a county wildlife site.

Jo Pullin and Sustainable Hatherleigh hope to create a resilient future for the area.

Jo Pullin from Sustainable Hatherleigh, Dr Susan Taheri from Growing Well Garden, Charles Staniland from Shallowford Farm and Pete Drew from Sampford Tree Wardens are finalists in the awards.

body.zh: 四个项目已获得 BBC 德文郡电台“Make a Difference Awards”环境类别提名。 Bow 的 Growing Well Garden、德文郡中部的 Sampford Peverell Tree Wardens、Dartmoor 的 Shallowford Farm 和 Sustainable Hatherleigh 因使社区变得更加环保、更加狂野和健康而受到认可。 他们通过多种方式做到这一点，从植树和种植蔬菜，到领导昆虫狩猎和重新发现自然。 Make a Difference 奖的获奖者将于 9 月 24 日在巴克法斯特修道院公布。 Growing Well Garden 是绿色社会处方项目的一部分，其中园艺被用作治疗工具，帮助医生以不同的方式与患者建立联系。 Susan Taheri 博士是 Bow Medical Practice 的 NHS 全科医生，也是 Growing Well Garden 项目的创始人 - 她说该计划重新点燃了她成为全科医生的热情。 她说，与在咨询室见到病人相比，在花园里会见病人更有好处，并将花园描述为她的“快乐的地方”。 “还有很多事情会弄脏你的双手，而且不用太担心细菌，”她说。 退休园艺家查尔斯·斯坦尼兰 (Charles Staniland) 从童年时期就开始热爱户外活动，现在他在那里做志愿者，教导年轻人要亲自动手。 他说他想展示一种更实际的食物处理方式，食物不仅仅出现在盘子上，而且这是他们可以做出的贡献。 斯坦尼兰希望该项目能够“鼓励新一代了解和重视他们周围的世界”。 “它让人们脱离了具体的环境——这是迈向绿色环境的非常好的第一步，”他说。 Sampford Peverell 树木管理员是一个独立、注重环保、以志愿者为基础的团体，负责照顾教区的绿化。 对于皮特·德鲁和其他狱长来说，保护环境是一项社区努力，通常由蛋糕提供动力。 该组织与议会和土地所有者合作，在公有土地上种植、保护和维护树木和树篱。 他说这是为了“为自己居住的地方感到自豪，并让当地空间对每个人来说都变得更好”。 可持续哈瑟利开展了一系列项目来支持社区，从领导昆虫狩猎、鼓励当地墓地种植野花和生物多样性，到社区堆肥和经营修理咖啡馆。 他们位于镇中心的地点现已被认定为县野生动物保护区。 乔·普林 (Jo Pullin) 和可持续哈瑟利 (Sustainable Hatherleigh) 希望为该地区创造一个充满活力的未来。 来自 Sustainable Hatherleigh 的 Jo Pullin、来自 Growing Well Garden 的 Susan Taheri 博士、来自 Shallowford Farm 的 Charles Staniland 和来自 Sampford Tree Wardens 的 Pete Drew 入围该奖项。 在 X 上关注 BBC Devon，...

reflection.en: The nomination of these four projects in Devon celebrates the tangible impact of community-led environmental initiatives. It echoes the Genesis account where Yahweh surveyed all that was made and declared it 'very good.' These efforts remind us that tending to the earth, growing food, and fostering wild spaces are acts that honor this original goodness.
reflection.zh: 德文郡这四个项目的提名，是对社区主导的环境倡议所产生的切实影响的庆祝。这呼应了《创世记》中雅伟审视他所造的一切，并宣告其“甚好”的记载。这些努力提醒我们，照料大地、种植食物和培育野外空间，都是荣耀这最初美善之举。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: New method predicts where massive earthquakes will strike
title.zh: 新方法预测哪里会发生大地震

summary.en: Scientists at UC Riverside have developed a method to identify the most likely locations for major earthquakes, providing a significant new tool for enhancing disaster preparedness in vulnerable seismic zones. This approach focuses on pinpointing areas of accumulating stress along fault lines, rather than predicting...
summary.zh: 加州大学河滨分校的科学家们开发出一种方法，可以识别出最有可能发生大地震的地点，为提高地震危险区域的灾害防备能力提供了强大的新工具。该方法着重于确定断层线上应力积累的区域，而不是预测地震的确切发生时间。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

UC Riverside scientists have developed a way to identify where Earth's biggest earthquakes are most likely to occur, offering a powerful new tool for improving disaster preparation in some of the most dangerous seismic regions.

Rather than predicting the timing of an earthquake, the method identifies where stress has been building along major faults, allowing scientists to determine where a rupture is likely to take place.

In a recent test detailed in a Geophysical Research Letters paper , the researchers found that their model highlighted the exact section of the Kamchatka subduction zone in eastern Russia where a massive earthquake later occurred.

The study was led by UCR geophysicists Gareth Funning and Axel Periollat, who study how Earth's surface slowly deforms as tectonic plates lock together before rupturing.

"Earthquakes capture headlines when they happen, but for years beforehand the fault is quietly accumulating strain," Funning said. "This strain can be measured."

The team's approach focuses on subduction zones, where one tectonic plate slides beneath another. These regions generate Earth's largest earthquakes, including those exceeding magnitude 8.5, and often produce devastating tsunamis.

Using GPS measurements of subtle ground movement, the researchers developed an algorithm that identifies portions of faults that are locked and storing energy. These locked regions, known as asperities, act like patches of friction that resist motion until enough stress builds to trigger a major earthquake.

The researchers had identified one such locked region beneath Russia's Kamchatka Peninsula before a large earthquake struck there. While the timing of the event was beyond the scope of their method, the rupture occurred exactly where their model indicated strain had accumulated.

"We had an idea where the strain was accumulating based on a relatively limited data set," Periollat said. "Seeing it work so well confirmed that this approach has real potential."

The findings also revealed that earthquakes occurring in the same region can behave differently. Although Kamchatka experienced giant earthquakes in both 1952 and 2025, the more recent event generated a much smaller tsunami, suggesting the shallowest portion of the fault slipped less than during the earlier rupture.

The researchers emphasize that their method cannot predict tsunami size or earthquake timing. However, narrowing where the greatest hazards exist could improve long-term planning and preparedness.

The team is now applying their approach to other major subduction zones in Japan, Mexico, New...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 加州大学河滨分校的科学家们开发出了一种方法来确定地球上最有可能发生最大地震的地方，为改善一些最危险的地震地区的备灾工作提供了一个强大的新工具。 该方法不是预测地震发生的时间，而是确定主要断层上应力产生的位置，使科学家能够确定可能发生破裂的位置。 在《地球物理研究快报》论文中详细介绍的最近一项测试中，研究人员发现他们的模型突出显示了俄罗斯东部堪察加半岛俯冲带的确切部分，那里后来发生了大地震。 这项研究由加州大学河滨分校的地球物理学家 Gareth Funning 和 Axel Periollat​​ 领导，他们研究了当构造板块在破裂之前锁定在一起时，地球表面如何缓慢变形。 法宁说：“地震发生时会成为头条新闻，但在地震发生之前的几年里，断层就在悄悄地积累压力。” “这种应变是可以测量的。” 该团队的方法侧重于俯冲带，其中一个构造板块滑到另一个构造板块下方。这些地区经常发生地球上最大的地震，包括超过 8.5 级的地震，并且经常引发毁灭性的海啸。 研究人员利用 GPS 测量微妙的地面运动，开发了一种算法，可以识别锁定并储存能量的断层部分。这些被称为粗糙体的锁定区域就像摩擦片一样抵抗运动，直到产生足够的压力来引发大地震。 在一场大地震发生之前，研究人员在俄罗斯堪察加半岛下方发现了一个这样的锁定区域。虽然事件发生的时间超出了他们的方法的范围，但破裂恰好发生在他们的模型表明应变累积的地方。 佩里奥拉特说：“我们根据相对有限的数据集了解了菌株在哪里积累。” “看到它的效果如此之好，证实了这种方法具有真正的潜力。” 研究结果还表明，同一地区发生的地震可能表现不同。尽管堪察加半岛在 1952 年和 2025 年都经历过大地震，但最近的事件引发的海啸要小得多，这表明断层最浅部分的滑动量比早期破裂时要少。 研究人员强调，他们的方法无法预测海啸规模或地震时间。然而，缩小存在最大危险的范围可以改善长期规划和准备工作。 该团队目前正在将他们的方法应用于日本、墨西哥、新墨西哥州等其他主要俯冲带。

reflection.en: The earth's deep processes remain a profound mystery, even as science advances our understanding. When we consider the immense power building beneath our feet, we are reminded of the limits of human knowledge and the awe-inspiring scale of creation. This scientific endeavor, while practical, also invites a posture of humility before the vast, intricate...
reflection.zh: 即使科学在不断进步，地球深层的运作过程仍然是一个深刻的奥秘。当我们思考脚下积聚的巨大力量时，我们被提醒人类知识的局限性，以及被造之物的宏伟规模。这项科学探索虽然具有实际意义，但也邀请我们在雅伟所设立的浩瀚而复杂的系统面前，保持谦卑的态度。

verse.textEn: Where were you when I laid the earth's foundation? Tell me, if you understand.
verse.textZh: 我立大地根基的时候，你在哪里呢？你若有聪明，只管说吧。

title.en: How haze from Indonesian fires impacts Southeast Asia
title.zh: 印度尼西亚火灾产生的烟雾如何影响东南亚

summary.en: Thick smog has blanketed parts of Indonesia as the vast archipelago battles fires that have burned large swaths of Borneo and Sumatra for weeks. The hazardous smoke has led to an increase in respiratory problems, forced schools to close, and drifted to neighboring countries including Malaysia, Singapore, and the...
summary.zh: 印尼大片地区被浓烟笼罩，因为这个广阔的群岛正在与已燃烧数周的婆罗洲和苏门答腊大片地区的火灾作斗争。危险的烟雾导致呼吸系统疾病增加，迫使学校关闭，并飘散到马来西亚、新加坡和菲律宾等邻国。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Thick smog has blanketed parts of Indonesia as the vast archipelago battles fires that have burned large swaths of Borneo and Sumatra for weeks.

The hazardous smoke has led to an increase in respiratory problems, forced schools to close and drifted to neighboring countries including Malaysia, Singapore and the Philippines.

Most of the fires are concentrated on the island of Borneo, home to vast tropical jungle that Indonesia shares with Brunei and Malaysia, as well as on Sumatra.

So far this year, nearly 300,000 hectares (741,000 acres) of land have burned in Indonesia, according to an independent estimate from the Nusantara Atlas portal.

Indonesia saw an uptick in carbon emissions since late July, and by the end of last month, levels were comparable to those in the previous El Niño years of 2015 and 2019, Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) senior scientist Mark Parrington told AFP.

"We're seeing already now... really extreme fire emissions comparable to those previous strong El Niño years, and also the extent of the smoke and the haze and the air quality impacts," Parrington said.

Fires in the archipelago released more than 23 million metric tons of carbon emissions between Aug. 28 and Sept. 3, according to CAMS' Fire Emission Watch portal.

That was higher than the 20.7 million metric tons of emissions from fires over the same period in 2015, which was a strong El Niño year.

Analysts said the El Niño weather phenomenon , which the United Nations said this week could turn out to be the strongest in four decades, has contributed to drier conditions in Indonesia and made it easier for fires to spread.

But slash-and-burn land-clearing practices also contributed to the damage, said David Gaveau, founder of the Nusantara Atlas.

"El Niño does not ignite fires. It creates the dry conditions that allow human-started fires to escape and become very large," he told AFP.

The fires are difficult to extinguish because many occurred on peatlands, a wetland ecosystem with layers of partially decomposed organic material that becomes flammable when dry.

Between January and August this year, more than 210,000 hotspots were detected in peatland areas across the country, according to NGO Pantau Gambut.

"Peat is a naturally wet ecosystem and stores large amounts of organic material. When peat is drained, this organic material is converted into fuel," Pantau Gambut spokesman Wahyu Perdana said.

More than 5 million people across Borneo and Sumatra are directly exposed to the health risks from haze, Deputy Health Minister Dante Saksono Harbuwono said last month.

More...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 浓烟笼罩了印度尼西亚部分地区，数周以来，广阔的群岛与大火烧毁了婆罗洲和苏门答腊岛的大片地区。 有害烟雾导致呼吸系统疾病增加，迫使学校关闭，并飘到马来西亚、新加坡和菲律宾等邻国。 大部分火灾集中在婆罗洲岛以及苏门答腊岛，婆罗洲岛是印度尼西亚与文莱和马来西亚共享的广阔热带丛林的所在地。 根据 Nusantara Atlas 门户网站的独立估计，今年到目前为止，印度尼西亚已有近 300,000 公顷（741,000 英亩）土地被烧毁。 哥白尼大气监测服务（CAMS）高级科学家马克·帕林顿（Mark Parrington）告诉法新社，自7月下旬以来，印度尼西亚的碳排放量有所上升，到上月底，其水平与前厄尔尼诺现象2015年和2019年的水平相当。 帕林顿说：“我们现在已经看到……与之前强烈的厄尔尼诺现象相媲美的极端火灾排放，以及烟雾和霾的程度以及空气质量的影响。” 根据 CAMS 的火灾排放观察门户网站的数据，8 月 28 日至 9 月 3 日期间，该群岛的火灾释放了超过 2300 万吨碳排放。 这高于 2015 年同期的 2070 万吨火灾排放量，2015 年是厄尔尼诺现象强烈的一年。 分析人士表示，联合国本周表示，厄尔尼诺天气现象可能是四十年来最严重的一次，它导致印度尼西亚气候更加干燥，并使火灾更容易蔓延。 但努桑塔拉地图集创始人戴维·加沃 (David Gaveau) 表示，刀耕火种的土地清理做法也造成了损害。 他告诉法新社：“厄尔尼诺现象不会引发火灾。它创造了干燥的条件，使人为引发的火灾得以蔓延并变得非常大。” 火灾很难扑灭，因为许多火灾发生在泥炭地，泥炭地是一种湿地生态系统，具有部分分解的有机物质层，干燥时会变得易燃。 据非政府组织 Pantau Gambut 称，今年 1 月至 8 月期间，全国泥炭地地区发现了超过 210,000 个热点。 Pantau Gambut 发言人 Wahyu Perdana 表示：“泥炭是一个天然湿润的生态系统，储存了大量的有机物质。当泥炭被排干时，这些有机物质就会转化为燃料。” 卫生部副部长丹特·萨克索诺·哈布沃诺 (Dante Saksono Harbuwono) 上个月表示，婆罗洲和苏门答腊岛有超过 500 万人直接面临雾霾的健康风险。 更多的...

This environmental devastation is a stark reminder of how human actions can wound the earth, God's creation. We are called to be stewards, recognizing the intricate wisdom and beauty Yahweh has woven into the natural...
reflection.zh: 在印度尼西亚婆罗洲和苏门答腊岛肆虐的火灾，用烟雾窒息了东南亚，影响了健康并导致学校关闭。这种环境破坏 starkly 提醒我们人类的行为如何会伤害大地，即雅伟的创造。我们被呼召成为管家，认识到雅伟编织到自然世界中的复杂智慧和美丽。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Indonesia rescues second orangutan mother and baby from wildfire
title.zh: 印度尼西亚救助第二只被野火威胁的母子猩猩

summary.en: Indonesian authorities announced on Saturday the rescue of an orangutan mother and her infant earlier this week. The pair had been threatened by wildfires encroaching on their habitat.
summary.zh: 印尼当局周六宣布，本周早些时候救助了一对母子猩猩。这对猩猩的栖息地受到野火侵蚀的威胁。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

An orangutan mother and her baby, threatened by wildfires encroaching on their habitat in Indonesia, were rescued earlier this week, authorities said in a statement Saturday.

The vast Southeast Asian archipelago has for weeks been fighting wildfires blanketing parts of Borneo and Sumatra with smog, with haze also contributing to air pollution in Malaysia, Singapore and the Philippines.

The orangutan pair had been under observation since July after being spotted in a plantation area near a forest in West Kalimantan, a local natural resources conservation agency said in a statement.

But authorities decided to evacuate them to a rescue center managed by the wildlife foundation Yayasan Inisiasi Alam Rehabilitasi Indonesia (YIARI) on Thursday as fire spread near their habitat.

Their health is being closely monitored by veterinarians, but a preliminary check found no burn injuries on the two great apes.

"Exposure to smoke over a period of time ... can affect the orangutan's respiratory system, especially when smoke concentrations in the habitat are very high," YIARI veterinarian Komara, who like many Indonesians uses only one name, said in a statement.

"Both individuals will continue to be monitored while they are at the rescue and rehabilitation center."

The latest rescue brings the number of orangutans evacuated because of wildfire threats to nine in less than a month in the Ketapang district of West Kalimantan province, YIARI operational director Argitoe Ranting said.

"This shows that fires not only destroy forests but also deprive animals of shelter and food," Ranting said.

Most animals "do not have many options" to relocate as their habitat burns, he added.

One orangutan died after being rescued last week, with a necropsy indicating smoke exposure as the cause of death, the West Kalimantan natural resources conservation agency said in a statement.

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 当局在周六的一份声明中表示，本周早些时候，一只猩猩母亲和她的孩子在印度尼西亚的栖息地受到野火侵袭的威胁后获救。 数周以来，广阔的东南亚群岛一直在扑灭笼罩婆罗洲和苏门答腊岛部分地区的野火，雾霾也加剧了马来西亚、新加坡和菲律宾的空气污染。 当地自然资源保护机构在一份声明中称，这对猩猩在西加里曼丹森林附近的种植园中被发现，自七月份以来一直受到观察。 但周四，由于火势在它们的栖息地附近蔓延，当局决定将它们疏散到由野生动物基金会 Yayasan Inisiasi Alam Rehabilitasi Indonesia (YIARI) 管理的救援中心。 兽医正在密切监测它们的健康状况，但初步检查发现这两只类人猿没有烧伤。 YIARI 兽医科马拉在一份声明中表示：“一段时间内暴露在烟雾中......会影响猩猩的呼吸系统，特别是当栖息地的烟雾浓度非常高时。”科马拉和许多印度尼西亚人一样只使用一个名字。 “两人在救援和康复中心期间将继续受到监控。” YIARI 运营总监 Argitoe Ranting 表示，最新的救援行动使西加里曼丹省吉打邦地区因山火威胁而被疏散的猩猩数量在不到一个月的时间内达到了 9 只。 兰廷说：“这表明火灾不仅摧毁了森林，还剥夺了动物的住所和食物。” 他补充说，随着栖息地被烧毁，大多数动物“没有太多选择”来重新安置。 西加里曼丹自然资源保护机构在一份声明中表示，一只猩猩上周获救后死亡，尸检显示其死因是接触烟雾。 物理学硕士，具有研究经验。长期科学新闻爱好者。在 Science X 的编辑成功中发挥着关键作用。完整档案 →

reflection.en: The image of a mother orangutan and her baby, vulnerable and threatened by the encroaching wildfires in Indonesia, calls to mind the responsibility to advocate for those who cannot speak for themselves. Proverbs 31:8-9 reminds us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for everyone who is குறிப்பிடable is to be denied justice."
reflection.zh: 在印度尼西亚，野火步步紧逼，一对母子猩猩面临着生存的威胁，这幅画面提醒我们，有责任为那些无法为自己发声的生命代言。《箴言》31:8-9 提醒我们：“你们要为不能说话的辩屈，为所有孤苦的人伸冤。”

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Spacecraft bound for Mercury begins 'tricky' arrival
title.zh: 飞往水星的航天器开始“棘手”的抵达

summary.en: After an eight-year journey, a spacecraft carrying European and Japanese probes began the monthslong, high-risk approach to Mercury on Thursday to study the sun-scorched planet.
summary.zh: 经过八年的旅程，一艘载有欧洲和日本探测器的航天器于周四开始其长达数月、高风险的水星抵达过程，以研究被太阳炙烤的行星。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

After an eight-year journey, a spacecraft carrying European and Japanese probes began the monthslong, high-risk approach to Mercury on Thursday to study the sun-scorched planet.

The BepiColombo mission set off from Earth in 2018 on a winding path to study the smallest and least understood planet in our solar system, with the aim of releasing the two probes into its orbit.

On Thursday, it began its arrival phase, described by the European Space Agency (ESA) as its "most operationally challenging planetary arrival sequences ever attempted."

Mercury's relatively tiny mass—it is only slightly bigger than the moon—means its gravitational pull is extremely weak compared to the sun, making it complex for spacecraft to approach the planet without ending up incinerated or lost in space.

"It's a very ambitious mission," Santa Martinez, the mission manager at ESA, told a news conference ahead of its arrival.

The spacecraft had to travel more than 10 billion kilometers (6.2 billion miles), executing a series of nine flybys to speed up, slow down and perfect its trajectory.

The two probes, which are attached to each other, finally separated Thursday from the transfer module that had propelled them—a crucial first step in the final approach.

It was the equivalent of "launching a new spacecraft. Only this spacecraft happens to be around a different planet," explained Ignacio Tanco, ESA's head of inner solar system mission operations, before the separation began.

On Thursday, Mercury was some 63 million km (39 million miles) from the sun and 200 million km (124 million miles) from Earth.

"At these distances ... any real-time operation becomes impossible," Tanco said, explaining that there was about a 30-minute delay between checks being performed and commands being executed from the ground to the craft.

It means the spacecraft had to check and execute the separation autonomously—a "tricky business," Tanco said.

The spacecraft autonomously cut the four mechanical struts connecting the orbiters to the module.

The separation took place at a speed of 40 centimeters (16 inches) per second, leaving the two entities relatively close given the vastness of space.

Due to the distance between the probes and Earth, the signal confirming the operation's success reached the control center in Darmstadt, Germany, nearly two hours later—at 1:53 p.m. GMT—sparking rounds of applause and cheers.

"This is the best-case scenario, that the telemetry comes exactly at the moment we expect it," said Elsa Montagnon, in charge of module operations at ESA.

reflection.en: The BepiColombo mission's eight-year voyage to Mercury represents a profound human drive to explore the unknown. This long and complex journey, culminating in a 'tricky' orbital insertion, speaks to our deep-seated desire to understand the cosmos, mirroring the Psalmist's awe at the heavens declaring their Creator's glory.
reflection.zh: 贝皮科伦坡号任务历时八年飞往水星的旅程，代表了人类探索未知的深刻驱动力。这次漫长而复杂的旅程，最终以一次“棘手”的轨道插入告终，体现了我们对理解宇宙的深切渴望，这与诗篇作者对诸天述说其造物主荣耀的敬畏之情相呼应。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Levitated magnet opens new frontier in search for ultraheavy dark matter
title.zh: 悬浮磁铁为搜寻超重暗物质开辟新领域

summary.en: Rice University researchers have employed a magnetically levitated particle in their quest to detect ultraheavy dark matter, thereby expanding the search for some of the most massive forms of invisible matter believed to be crucial for galactic cohesion. The team, under the leadership of Christopher Tunnell, utilized...
summary.zh: 莱斯大学的研究人员使用一个磁悬浮粒子来搜寻超重暗物质，从而扩展了对被认为对星系凝聚至关重要的某些最重形式的暗物质的搜寻。该团队由物理学和天文学副教授克里斯托弗·塔内尔领导，他们使用了一个微小的漂浮磁铁作为高灵敏度探测器，以记录超重暗物质粒子通过时产生的微弱推力。

body.en: Rice University researchers have used a magnetically levitated particle to search for ultraheavy dark matter, extending the hunt for some of the heaviest possible forms of the invisible matter thought to hold galaxies together. Led by Christopher Tunnell, associate professor of physics and astronomy, the researchers used a tiny floating magnet as a highly sensitive detector designed to register the faint push an ultraheavy dark matter particle could produce as it passed through.
body.zh: 莱斯大学的研究人员使用磁悬浮粒子来寻找超重暗物质，扩大了对一些最重的不可见物质的搜寻范围，这些物质被认为是将星系聚集在一起。在物理学和天文学副教授克里斯托弗·通内尔（Christopher Tunnell）的带领下，研究人员使用一个微小的浮动磁铁作为高灵敏度探测器，旨在记录超重暗物质粒子通过时可能产生的微弱推力。

reflection.en: The universe holds mysteries far beyond our immediate sight, like the dark matter scientists are now probing with innovative tools. Job 12:7 reminds us that even the natural world, from the smallest creature to the vast cosmos, can teach us about the Creator's intricate design and wisdom. This pursuit of understanding the unseen reminds us of the profound...
reflection.zh: 宇宙中隐藏着我们肉眼看不见的奥秘，就像科学家们现在正在用创新的工具探测的暗物质一样。约伯记12:7提醒我们，即使是自然界，从最小的生物到浩瀚的宇宙，都能教导我们关于创造者的精妙设计和智慧。这种对看不见之物的理解的追求，让我们想起雅伟创造的深邃广博。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Trump signs order to remove endangered species protection for grey wolves
title.zh: 特朗普签署命令，取消灰狼濒危物种保护

summary.en: The US president says the move will help ranchers, but conservationists say it could derail efforts to recover populations. The executive order removes endangered species protection for the grey wolf and the Mexican wolf, potentially allowing ranchers to kill them to protect livestock, despite conservation groups'...
summary.zh: 美国总统称此举将有助于牧场主，但环保人士表示这可能会破坏种群恢复的努力。该行政命令取消了灰狼和墨西哥狼的濒危物种保护，可能允许牧场主为保护牲畜而杀死它们，尽管环保团体担心这会影响长期的种群恢复工作。

body.en:
Donald Trump has signed an executive order to remove endangered species protection for the grey wolf and a subspecies, the Mexican wolf.

The US president's decision could pave the way for pastoral farmers to kill the canines to protect their livestock. His order said ranchers played a "vital role" in the food supply chain and American cultural heritage.

But conservation groups have criticised the move, saying it could derail long-term efforts to recover the endangered wolf populations.

There were 319 Mexican wolves in the wild in the US in 2025, up from just four when they were reintroduced in 1998, US Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS) figures show.

Meanwhile, there are roughly 18,000 grey wolves across the US, though they are still considered endangered as most of their habitat has been destroyed by humans.

An attempt to de-list them at a federal level in 2022 became tied up in litigation, and some campaigners have indicated they intend to do the same of the US Department of Interior acts on Trump's order.

The executive order does not give ranchers immediate license to shoot wolves preying on livestock, but instead gives Interior Secretary Doug Burgum 90 days to determine whether the grey and Mexican wolf populations had recovered enough to warrant being taken off the endangered species list.

Noting that US livestock herds were at a 75-year low while demand for beef had risen by 10% in the past decade, the order added: "More can and should be done to support this critical industry."

However, environmental groups pointed to studies that suggested wolf attacks on livestock were rare and had little impact on ranchers' income.

"This is a huge distraction to placate a handful of ranchers and make them believe that wolves are a greater threat than President Trump's own policies," said Greta Anderson, deputy director of Western Watersheds Project, which works to conserve wildlife in western US states.

The Wolf Conservation Center noted that ranchers were entitled to up to 100% compensation for any livestock losses caused by wolves under the current system, with individual states providing funding for programmes to deter attacks.

"The Mexican grey wolf is not recovered simply because the population has grown," said Claire Musser, executive director of the Grand Canyon Wolf Recovery Project. "Weakening federal protections now would put decades of recovery work at risk."

The executive order comes as the Trump administration is seeking to lower record-high beef prices for consumers, driven by drought and an outbreak of parasites in US beef stocks.

Ranchers have been frustrated by Trump's decision to loosen restrictions on beef imports to address price rises, putting pressure on their already tight margins.
